bio.p1: ALBASAX is an international Pop Artist, Performer, Singer and Saxophonist, blending what he loves to define as his "Cinematic Glamour Pop" with live instruments and dramatic performance into a single artistic universe. Graduated from the prestigious Santa Cecilia Conservatory of Rome, he combines a solid musical foundation with contemporary pop, electronic soundscapes and theatrical storytelling.
bio.p2: His artistic world is inspired by Hollywood cinema, theatrical aesthetics and pop spectacle, shaping a distinctive identity where elegance, glamour, vulnerability and power coexist.
bio.p3: Driven by the belief that music is not only meant to be heard, but also seen, felt and lived, ALBASAX transforms each performance into a cinematic experience where music becomes a film and the stage becomes a scene.
bio.p4: He is currently working on his international debut album, written in English and Spanish, conceived as a cinematic journey designed for a global audience, where sound, image and performance merge into one immersive vision.
